long_description:
Tell Overheard what you're deciding, like how to fix churn or which feature to build next. It writes the interview, talks to your customers by voice, and comes back with answers.

Most teams make these calls without hearing from customers because setting up interviews takes weeks and nobody owns it. Overheard gets you answers in days - no researcher needed.

Teams use Overheard to find out why customers churn, test concepts and prototypes, set pricing, and run win/loss interviews.
name: Overheard
one_liner: Know what your customers want, because they told you.
